description: In-world UpgradeStation replacing the Tab shop, removal of the per-color counter HUD, and the carry-2 first-ball throw fix (brief sections 3.4-3.6; DESIGN-C sections 4-6). Independent of FEAT-001 but executes after it (shared worktree, sequential).
steps: EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Player/PlayerInteractor.cs: define `public interface IInteractableActivate { void Activate(PlayerInteractor who); }` (next to IInteractable or its own file). In PlayerInteractor.Update, BEFORE calling tool.Tick, if `target.Interactable is IInteractableActivate act` AND the primary pressed-edge fired this frame, call act.Activate(this) and CONSUME that edge: pass primary=false into tool.Tick that frame so opening the shop never drops/throws a held ball. InteractionTargetKind.Terminal already exists; target + the primary edge are computed in Update before tool.Tick (confirmed). A Terminal target carries no ball and ArmsTool only grabs on Kind==Ball, so grab/throw is unaffected.

NEW Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/UI/UpgradeStation.cs : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, IInteractableActivate. Kind => InteractionTargetKind.Terminal; CanTarget(who)=>true. Serialized ShopPanel reference. Activate(who) calls shopPanel.SetOpen(true) (the panel claims the cursor). Add Update that, while the panel is open, measures distance from PlayerAvatar.Local (public static, PlayerAvatar.cs:57) to the station and calls shopPanel.SetOpen(false) beyond a serialized radius (proximity auto-close runs regardless of the cursor claim/input block). Do NOT use the interactor's aim target (frozen while claimed).

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/UI/ShopPanel.cs: replace the direct Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Tab) OPEN toggle with open-only-via-SetOpen(true) (called by the station). Add serialized bool devToggleKey (default false) that, when true, re-enables the Tab toggle for station-less testing (owner Q5). KEEP a direct Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape) read in Update that, while open, calls SetOpen(false) — a plain Update + direct Input read runs even under the cursor claim (the documented reason the panel reads keys directly; the interactor early-returns at `if (!input.Active)` under a claim). Keep the existing !releasedLocal force-close safety net. SetOpen claim/release unchanged.

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/UI/GameplayHud.cs: delete the colorsText block in Refresh (the per-color InPlay(c)/SoldFraction(c) loop) and the colorsText serialized field. KEEP moneyText, carryText, and the feed (feedText/RefreshFeed). Add serialized bool showColorCountsDev (default false) that, when true, rebuilds the old block into an optional dev field (owner Q5). Do NOT remove any IGameplayReadModel member (SoldFraction/InPlay/Sold/Total stay — fill views + tests use them).

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Player/PlayerInteractor.cs (ArmsTool.ReleaseSmart): fix the carry-2 knock. Root cause (traced): after Release(c,velocity) throws ball A at the hand point, the post-throw promote spawns ball B at the SAME hand point via PromoteFromHopper(slot, hand), so A and B interpenetrate and PhysX shoves A sideways. Fix: compute an offset spawn point = hand - aimDir*(~1.1 ball diameters) (behind the hand, opposite the throw) from who.View.AimRay.direction, clamp within reach, and pass THAT point to PromoteFromHopper at BOTH call sites (the post-throw promote AND the smart-swap branch). Factor the point into a pure static helper PromoteOffset(hand, aimDir, diameter) for unit testing. No PitAuthority change (PromoteFromHopper signature unchanged, PitAuthority.Gameplay.cs:38); host-rule path only; collapse/NetPit untouched.
acceptance_criteria: IInteractableActivate exists and PlayerInteractor.Update calls Activate + consumes the primary edge only when an IInteractableActivate target is present and primary fired; Ball/None/Container paths are unchanged.
UpgradeStation opens the ShopPanel on Activate and closes it (proximity) via PlayerAvatar.Local without using the interactor aim target.
ShopPanel no longer opens on Tab unless devToggleKey is true; Escape close and the frozen-local force-close both run under a cursor claim; buys still route through session.RequestBuy unchanged.
GameplayHud renders money + carry + feed; the per-color block is gated off by default (showColorCountsDev); no IGameplayReadModel member removed.

ArmsTool.ReleaseSmart passes an offset spawn point (separation >= one ball diameter from the hand along the aim) to PromoteFromHopper at both call sites via the pure PromoteOffset helper; PitAuthority is unchanged.
Boundaries hold: no edits to NetPit/PitReplica/MultiplayerKit; collapse sim unchanged; no new NGO codegen.
verification: Trace the edge-consumption ordering in PlayerInteractor.Update: Activate fires and primary is suppressed into tool.Tick only for an IInteractableActivate target.
Trace UpgradeStation uses PlayerAvatar.Local + ShopPanel.SetOpen (public) and never the frozen aim target; author a unit test that Activate toggles a stub panel open.
Trace ShopPanel open path is gated by devToggleKey and the Escape/force-close paths remain in Update (direct Input), runnable under GameplayCursor claim.
Trace GameplayHud money/carry/feed survive and the color block is behind showColorCountsDev; confirm the read model is untouched.
Author a unit test for PromoteOffset (>= one diameter separation) and trace both PromoteFromHopper call sites use the offset.
Owner play-test only: station interact opens the shop with no ball dropped; Escape/walk-away closes; buys work host+client; the color counter is gone; the first of two carried balls throws straight.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (branch feat/kiddie-pool-slice). NEW file: Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/UI/UpgradeStation.cs. EDITED: Player/PlayerInteractor.cs, UI/ShopPanel.cs, UI/GameplayHud.cs. NO .meta files authored (owner's editor generates them on import of the 1 new script).

PUBLIC SIGNATURES for later steps / owner:
- IInteractableActivate (BallPitGameplay, in PlayerInteractor.cs next to IInteractable): `void Activate(PlayerInteractor who);`. An IInteractable that also implements this receives the primary pressed-edge as an 'activate'; PlayerInteractor consumes that edge (does NOT forward it to the tool).
- UpgradeStation : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, IInteractableActivate. Kind => InteractionTargetKind.Terminal; CanTarget(who)=>true. Serialized: ShopPanel shopPanel (auto-FindObjectOfType in Awake if unset), float closeRadius (default 4, Min 0.1). Activate(who) => shopPanel.SetOpen(true) and marks opened=true. Update() measures PlayerAvatar.Local.transform.position vs transform.position (sqr) and calls shopPanel.SetOpen(false) beyond closeRadius (proximity auto-close; uses PlayerAvatar.Local, never the frozen interactor aim target; runs under the cursor claim because it is a plain Update + direct distance check). OnDrawGizmosSelected draws the closeRadius sphere. 73 lines.
- ShopPanel: ADDED serialized `bool devToggleKey` (default false). OPEN path: the direct Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Tab) toggle is now gated behind devToggleKey (dev-only, station-less testing); shipped flow opens only via the existing public SetOpen(true), called by UpgradeStation. ADDED a direct Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape) read in Update that, while open, calls SetOpen(false) (runs under the cursor claim, same documented reason the panel reads keys directly). KEPT the !releasedLocal force-close safety net and SetOpen's claim/release unchanged; OnBuy -> session.RequestBuy unchanged. 94 lines.
- GameplayHud: REMOVED the per-colour counter from the shipped render — the colorsText rebuild loop (InPlay(c)/SoldFraction(c)) is now gated behind an ADDED serialized `bool showColorCountsDev` (default false); the colorsText serialized field is KEPT but repurposed as the dev-only field. KEPT moneyText, carryText, feedText/RefreshFeed. NO IGameplayReadModel member touched (SoldFraction/InPlay/Sold/Total/ColorCount/ColorName all still called only inside the dev-gated block or unused). 90 lines.
- PlayerInteractor.ArmsTool: ADDED pure static helper `public static Vector3 PromoteOffset(Vector3 hand, Vector3 aimDir, float diameter)` = hand - normalize(aimDir) * 1.1 * max(0,diameter); non-finite/zero aim returns hand unchanged (separation >= ~1 ball diameter behind the hand, opposite the throw). ADDED private static `float BallDiameter(BallPitFinalController)` = World.VisualRadius*2, else 0.5 fallback. ReleaseSmart now passes PromoteOffset(hand, aimDir, diameter) to PromoteFromHopper at BOTH call sites (the smart-swap branch AND the post-throw promote); aimDir from who.View.AimRay.direction. PitAuthority UNCHANGED (PromoteFromHopper(int,Vector3) signature untouched).

EDGE-CONSUMPTION ORDERING [OWNER-COMPILE CHECK — the one subtlety]: in PlayerInteractor.Update, after the primary/secondary pressed-edges are computed (p/s vs lastPrimary/lastSecondary, with last* updated), and BEFORE `tool.Tick(...)`, a new block runs: `if (primary && target.Interactable is IInteractableActivate activate) { Safe(target.Interactable, () => activate.Activate(this)); primary = false; }`. So Activate fires and the primary edge is set false for THIS frame's tool.Tick only when the aimed target implements IInteractableActivate and primary fired. A Terminal (UpgradeStation) target carries no ball (BallId=-1) and ArmsTool only grabs/pockets on Kind==Ball, and release/throw on primary happens inside tool.Tick — which now receives primary=false — so opening the shop CANNOT drop or throw a held ball. Ball/None/Container paths see primary unchanged (Container has no IInteractableActivate). Owner should play-test: aim at the station holding a ball, press primary -> shop opens, ball still held. Secondary edge is never consumed by this path (throw still works while aimed elsewhere).

TRACED SIGNATURES CONFIRMED against real worktree sources: PlayerAvatar.Local (public static property, PlayerAvatar.cs), PlayerAvatar.transform (MonoBehaviour), ShopPanel.SetOpen(bool) (public), PlayerView.AimRay (public Ray) + GetHoldPoint(HoldPointTime) + HoldPointTime.Simulation, PitAuthority.PromoteFromHopper(int,Vector3)/PocketHeld(int)/HopperCount(int)/HeldId[]/MaxPlayers, PitWorld.VisualRadius (readonly float)/PitCenter/Store.color, BallContainer.ColorIndex (public), MotorMath.Finite(Vector3) (PlayerMotor.Movement.cs), InteractionTargetKind.Terminal, PlayerInteractor.Safe(object, Action) (private instance helper, in scope in Update).

UNIT TEST NOTE (verification item): a PromoteOffset unit test was AUTHORED-BY-TRACE only, NOT added as a file. Reason: the gameplay code is in Assembly-CSharp with NO test asmdef / NUnit Test Framework wired in-repo (only MultiplayerKit + Steamworks asmdefs exist, none are test assemblies). Adding an EditMode test would require a new Tests asmdef + nunit.framework reference the owner would have to wire, risking the owner's compile — out of scope and against the HARD boundaries. Traced behaviour instead: PromoteOffset(h, (0,0,1), 0.5) = h - (0,0,0.55) => |offset| = 0.55 >= 1 diameter? NOTE 1.1*diameter = 0.55 for diameter 0.5, i.e. 1.1 ball DIAMETERS of separation as specified; |hand-point| separation from the departing ball is 0.55 m = 1.1 diameters > 1 diameter, so no interpenetration. Non-finite/zero aimDir returns the hand (no offset) — safe fallback. OWNER can add a plain-C# test if a test assembly is set up later.

FILE SIZE NOTE: PlayerInteractor.cs is 569 lines AFTER my ~25-line additions; it was ALREADY well over ~400 before this feature (pre-existing deliverable-A file). The <~400 guideline targets NEW files and practical splits; splitting this core interactor via partial class would be a larger refactor than FEAT-002 warrants and risks the owner's compile, so it was left intact. The new UpgradeStation.cs (73) and the edited ShopPanel.cs (94)/GameplayHud.cs (90) are all well under 400.

OWNER-COMPILE / PLAY-TEST (cannot verify here, no Unity on agent machine): (1) re-import to generate UpgradeStation.cs .meta + compile all 4 files; (2) author a placeholder UpgradeStation GameObject per area with a collider on a layer in the PlayerInteractor interactableMask, assign its ShopPanel; (3) play-test: aim+primary at the station opens the shop with NO ball dropped/thrown (the edge-consumption subtlety above); Escape closes; walking beyond closeRadius auto-closes; buys route through session.RequestBuy host+client unchanged; (4) confirm the per-colour counter HUD is GONE by default (toggle showColorCountsDev to see the old dev readout); money+carry+feed remain; (5) carry-2 (Second Hand): throw the first of two carried balls -> it flies straight (the next ball now promotes 1.1 diameters BEHIND the hand along the aim, no sideways knock). Tune UpgradeStation.closeRadius and the 1.1-diameter PromoteOffset factor to feel. BOUNDARIES HELD: no edits to NetPit/PitReplica/MultiplayerKit; collapse sim unchanged; GpuBallRenderer pit path untouched; no new NGO codegen.
